name: lifeos_intake
description: Push an important Claude conversation update into AI Life OS so it can update Now Card, Today Timeline, user state, tasks, deadlines, and constraints.

auth.description: Shared token configured as LIFEOS_INTAKE_TOKEN on the deployed AIOS backend.

rawInput.description: The user's exact message or a concise excerpt that should update AIOS.

timestamp.description: Current timestamp. If omitted, AIOS will use server time.

conversationSummary.description: Short context summary when the raw input depends on earlier conversation.

externalConversationId.description: Optional Claude conversation identifier or user-visible reference.
